stories.title: SEC Proposes First Major Update to Transfer Agent Rules in Decades, With a Blockchain Nod
stories.summary: The SEC proposed a broad update to its transfer agent rules. These rules have not changed in decades. The proposal includes a nod to blockchain technology. The report does not give full details on scope or timeline.
stories.whyItMatters: Transfer agent rules govern how securities get recorded and moved. A blockchain-friendly update could open the door to more tokenized securities infrastructure.
whatToWatch: The start of the public comment period
Final rule language on blockchain provisions
Reaction from transfer agents and securities firms
questions: What specific blockchain provisions does the proposal include?
When does the rule take effect if adopted?

sources.title: SEC proposes broad update to decades-old transfer agent rules with blockchain nod

stories.title: Ripple, Coincheck Strike Digital Asset Custody Deals in Asia
stories.summary: Ripple and Coincheck each announced new digital asset custody infrastructure deals in Asia. The deals add to a build-out of institutional custody services in the region.
stories.whyItMatters: Custody infrastructure is a prerequisite for institutional crypto adoption. Asia is a key growth market for this build-out.
whatToWatch: Further custody partnerships in Asia
Regulatory responses from Asian financial authorities
questions: Which clients or markets do these deals cover?
What are the terms of each deal?

stories.title: Strategy Cites MSCI's Own SEC Filings to Fight Index-Exclusion Threat
stories.summary: Strategy, the large corporate bitcoin holder, is pushing back on an MSCI threat tied to a reported $24 billion in exposure. Strategy is using MSCI's own statements to the SEC as part of its case.
stories.whyItMatters: Index inclusion drives passive fund flows into MSTR shares, so the outcome affects one of the largest public bitcoin proxies.
whatToWatch: MSCI's final decision on Strategy's index status
Any SEC response or comment
MSTR share price reaction
questions: What exactly did MSCI threaten to do?
What is the timeline for MSCI's decision?

stories.title: Bitcoin Holds Steady as Global Bond Selloff Pushes Japanese Yields to New High
stories.summary: Bitcoin traded flat even as a global bond bear market continued. The selloff pushed Japanese government bond yields to a new high.
stories.whyItMatters: Rising bond yields affect risk appetite across markets, so bitcoin's muted reaction matters to anyone tracking its macro correlation.
whatToWatch: Further moves in Japanese government bond yields

questions: Is bitcoin decoupling from macro risk assets, or just lagging behind them?
